item.title: LvivPy4: Threading vs asyncio - benchmark
item.description: Slides and video of lightning talk about comparing context switch speed using threading and asyncio libraries from LvivPy#4 conference, held on May 30, 2015. Video recording: Slides: LvivPy4 - Threading vs asyncio from Roman Anigon Recordings of all talks: http://lvivpy.org.ua/?p=375 Once again I’d like to thank the organizers for a mega decent event.
